title: LIVE PRECIPITABLE WATER VAPOR
source_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km precipitable water analysis, hourly cycles
variable: PWAT entire atmosphere (considered as a single layer), analysis step
source_units: kg m-2 (= mm of liquid water)
what: Column-integrated atmospheric water vapor from the operational HRRR analysis: the total water held in the full atmospheric column above each point, expressed as the depth of liquid water if it all condensed. Deep values mark moisture transport and heavy-precipitation potential in Great Lakes weather systems.
field: Atmospheric moisture science tracks precipitable water as the reservoir feeding clouds and precipitation. Unlike relative humidity (a near-surface saturation percentage), it integrates the whole column, revealing atmospheric rivers, lake-effect moisture plumes, and storm-system moisture transport. Units are millimeters of equivalent liquid-water depth.
